overview: Federal Reserve officials are expected to restart rate increases in December as inflation concerns persist, impacting broader economic markets. In commercial real estate, Blackstone Mortgage Trust reported a massive third-quarter loss while cutting older office loans. San Francisco real estate interests have raised millions to defeat a local social housing ballot measure, alongside other regional developments. Meanwhile, low-income tenants on Kauaʻi await critical home repairs months after storm damage, and Maui faces ongoing flood advisories.

items.title: The Fed Risks Falling Behind in its Inflation Fight
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials are expected to restart interest rate increases in December, though future moves will depend closely on incoming economic data.

items.title: Blackstone Mortgage Trust Reports $327.6M Loss as It Cuts Older Office Loans
items.summary: Blackstone Mortgage Trust reported a third-quarter net loss of $327.6 million as the firm cut exposure to older office loans.

items.title: Equinix Raises Outlook Again as Data Center Bookings Hit Record in Q3
items.summary: Equinix raised its 2026 financial outlook after booking record data center demand driven by artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure growth.

items.title: Real-estate money floods fight against San Francisco ‘social housing’ measure
items.summary: San Francisco real estate stakeholders have raised over $2.7 million to defeat an upcoming local affordable housing ballot measure.

items.title: Bilal Mahmood can’t quit cheap groceries: S.F. supervisor hatches new produce-buyers club
items.summary: San Francisco Supervisor Bilal Mahmood has launched a new produce-buyers club partnering with local grocers to lower wholesale and retail food prices.

items.title: Two Months After Lowell, Kauaʻi’s Low-Income Tenants Await Repairs
items.summary: Low-income tenants on Kauaʻi are still waiting for vital apartment repairs months after storm damage, leaving them vulnerable to heavy rains.

items.title: Flood advisories posted for parts of Maui as rain soaks Valley Isle
items.summary: Flood advisories were posted for parts of Maui as heavy rain continued to drench ground already soaked by days of wet weather.

items.title: Shopping-cart bill draws criticism over impact on homeless
items.summary: Honolulu officials are debating a shopping-cart bill that aims to address public safety concerns but faces criticism for unfairly targeting the homeless.

wiki.title: Chimacum Creek
wiki.extract: Chimacum Creek is a stream in Jefferson County, Washington, United States. Located on the base of the Quimper Peninsula in the northeast of the larger Olympic Peninsula, the main stem originates from a series of springs and ponds in the forested hills south of Discovery Bay. It flows south from its source before turning east and eventually north, taking in many small tributaries before it enters the broad Chimacum Valley, an agricultural region where the stream has been extensively channelized. After taking in its largest tributary, the East Fork Chimacum, near the community of Chimacum, it enters a tight ravine where it meets the sea in the community of Port Hadlock-Irondale, creating a small estuary and an area of intertidal wetland as it enters Port Townsend Bay.
